key_concepts: Colloid particles are intermediate in size between solution and suspension particles
Colloid particles remain dispersed and do not settle
Colloids can exhibit both solid and liquid properties
A light beam becomes visible when passed through a colloid
The scattering of light by a colloid is called the Tyndall effect
Milk is a colloid whose particles do not settle at the bottom
Milk mixed with water forms a colloid
Smoke is a colloid that can be harmful
Clouds are colloids that spread sunlight
Common household colloids include milk, smoke, clouds, and cornstarch-water mixtures
